"""Fresh W35 command-UID and sampled whole-cycle telemetry, not a skill gate.

Reads only caller-supplied ORIGINAL command/terminal buffers. No SDK, actor,

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math

MODEL='ad504fec819b22f10fd1caf7befc59c1988c7609fe15373ab8851ef95942df3f'

class TypedRows:
    def __init__(self,directory,name,schema,maximum_bytes=128*1024**2):
        self.path=Path(directory)/name;self.file=self.path.open('xb');self.hash=hashlib.sha256()
        self.bytes=0;self.rows=0;self.limit=maximum_bytes;self.limited=False;self.schema=schema;self.closed=False
    def append(self,row):
        raw=(json.dumps(dict(schema=self.schema,control_index_base=0,**row),separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode('utf8')
        if self.bytes+len(raw)>self.limit:self.limited=True;return False
        self.file.write(raw);self.hash.update(raw);self.bytes+=len(raw);self.rows+=1;return True
    def finish(self):
        if not self.closed:self.file.close();self.closed=True
        assert self.path.stat().st_size==self.bytes
        return dict(path=str(self.path),bytes=self.bytes,SHA=self.hash.hexdigest(),rows=self.rows,
            schema=self.schema,source_SHA=MODEL,stream_SHA_produced_without_reread=True,
            retention_limited=self.limited,default_reader_transfer='metadata_only_not_JSONL_contents')

def profile_key(t,cmd):
    mode=t.zeros(cmd.num_envs,device=cmd.device,dtype=t.long)
    mode[cmd.is_standing_env]=1
    mode[cmd.linear&(cmd.linear_vx<0)]=2;mode[cmd.linear&(cmd.linear_vx>0)]=3
    mode[cmd.moving&(cmd.signed_yaw<0)]=4;mode[cmd.moving&(cmd.signed_yaw>0)]=5
    mode[cmd.eligible_flat&~cmd.is_standing_env&~cmd.linear&~cmd.moving]=6
    key=(cmd.family+1)*7+mode
    assert key.shape==(cmd.num_envs,) and bool(((key>=0)&(key<42)).all())
    return key

class W35UIDCycleBook:
    def __init__(self,t,n,device,out):
        self.t=t;self.n=n;self.device=device;self.ids=t.arange(n,device=device)
        self.uid=t.zeros(n,dtype=t.long,device=device);self.episode=self.uid.clone();self.source_episode=self.uid.clone()
        self.active=t.zeros(n,dtype=t.bool,device=device);self.known=self.active.clone()
        self.sample_key=self.uid.clone();self.first_control=self.uid.clone();self.command_controls=self.uid.clone()
        self.start_tick=self.uid.clone();self.first_acted=self.uid.clone()-1
        self.moving_controls=self.uid.clone();self.zero_controls=self.uid.clone()

        self.sample_command=t.zeros(n,3,device=device);self.sample_direction=t.zeros(n,device=device)
        self.sample_yaw=self.sample_direction.clone();self.start_timer=self.sample_direction.clone()
        self.closed=t.zeros(42,n,dtype=t.long,device=device)

        self.left=self.closed.clone();self.reset=self.closed.clone();self.window=self.closed.clone()
        self.complete_controls=self.closed.clone();self.complete_moving_controls=self.closed.clone()
        self.complete_errors=t.zeros(42,3,n,device=device);self.complete_moving_errors=self.complete_errors.clone()
        self.instance_records=TypedRows(out,'W35_OBSERVED_COMMAND_UID_RECORDS_ACTUAL.jsonl','W35_observed_command_uid_v1')
        self.cycle_records=TypedRows(out,'W35_OBSERVED_SAME_UID_SIGNED_CYCLE_RECORDS_ACTUAL.jsonl','W35_same_uid_sampled_signed_cycle_v1')
        self.cycle_active=self.active.clone();self.cycle_uid=self.uid.clone();self.cycle_key=self.uid.clone()
        self.cycle_count=self.uid.clone();self.cycle_turn=self.sample_direction.clone()
        self.cycle_progress=self.sample_direction.clone();self.cycle_ref=self.sample_direction.clone()
        self.cycle_direction=self.sample_direction.clone();self.cycle_sign=self.sample_direction.clone()
        self.cycle_start_phase=self.uid.clone();self.cycle_cross_phase=self.active.clone()
        self.cycle_first_control=self.uid.clone()
        self.cycle_events=t.zeros(3,42,n,dtype=t.long,device=device)

        self.last_terminated=self.active.clone();self.last_truncated=self.active.clone()

    def _snapshot(self,cmd):
        return dict(key=profile_key(self.t,cmd),command=cmd.command,direction=cmd.direction,signed_yaw=cmd.signed_yaw,timer=cmd.time_left)

    def _open(self,cmd,ids,known):
        assert not bool(self.active[ids].any())
        self.uid[ids]+=1;self.active[ids]=True;self.known[ids]=bool(known)
        self.source_episode[ids]=cmd._env._e1_episode[ids]
        p=self._snapshot(cmd);self.sample_key[ids]=p['key'][ids]
        self.sample_command[ids]=p['command'][ids];self.sample_direction[ids]=p['direction'][ids]
        self.sample_yaw[ids]=p['signed_yaw'][ids];self.start_timer[ids]=p['timer'][ids]
        self.command_controls[ids]=0;self.moving_controls[ids]=0;self.zero_controls[ids]=0
        self.error[ids]=0;self.moving_error[ids]=0;self.profile_bits[ids]=0;self.first_control[ids]=self.current_control
        self.start_tick[ids]=int(cmd._env._sim_step_counter);self.first_acted[ids]=-1
        self.last_terminated[ids]=False;self.last_truncated[ids]=False
        self.opened_events+=len(ids)

    def adopt_observed_initial_packet(self,packet):
        term=packet['term'];ids=packet['ids']
        assert len(ids)==self.n and self.t.equal(ids,self.ids) and packet['tick']==0
        assert not bool(self.active.any())
        self._open(term,ids,True);self.initial_adopted=True

    def original_event(self,event,term,ids,**metadata):
        if event=='BEFORE_ORIGINAL_RESET':
            self.close(ids,'reset',natural_timer_end=False);self.episode[ids]+=1
        elif event=='AFTER_ORIGINAL_RESAMPLE':
            # Resample inside reset begins a fresh command, never a complete old
            # command. Original prior timer is observed, not decremented here.
            prior=metadata.get('original_prior_timer')
            natural=not metadata['within_original_reset'] and prior is not None
            if natural:
                natural_ids=ids[prior<=0];other_ids=ids[prior>0]
                self.close(natural_ids,'resample',natural_timer_end=True)
                self.close(other_ids,'resample',natural_timer_end=False)
            else:self.close(ids,'resample',natural_timer_end=False)
            self._open(term,ids,True)
        else:raise ValueError('Unexpected original command event '+event)

    def begin(self,cmd,ctx):
        self.current_control=int(ctx['control'])
        missing=self.ids[~self.active]
        if len(missing):self._open(cmd,missing,False)
        ctx['observed_command_uid']=self.uid.clone();ctx['observed_episode_uid']=self.episode.clone()
        # A profile/eligibility/direction change breaks a cycle segment but never
        # manufactures another command UID or resampling event.
        valid=ctx['moving']&ctx['eligible']
        same=(ctx['profile_key']==self.cycle_key)&(self.uid==self.cycle_uid)&(ctx['direction']==self.cycle_direction)&(self.t.sign(ctx['signed_yaw'])==self.cycle_sign)
        ended=self.ids[self.cycle_active&(~valid|~same)]
        self._partial_cycle(ended,'original_mode_eligibility_profile_or_direction_change')
        start=self.ids[valid&~self.cycle_active]
        if len(start):
            self.cycle_active[start]=True;self.cycle_uid[start]=self.uid[start];self.cycle_key[start]=ctx['profile_key'][start]
            self.cycle_direction[start]=ctx['direction'][start];self.cycle_sign[start]=self.t.sign(ctx['signed_yaw'][start])
            self.cycle_count[start]=0;self.cycle_turn[start]=0;self.cycle_progress[start]=0;self.cycle_ref[start]=0
            self.cycle_start_phase[start]=0 if self.current_control<100 else 1
            self.cycle_cross_phase[start]=False;self.cycle_first_control[start]=self.current_control

    def observe_original_terminal(self,ctx,root_xy,heading,errors,terminated,truncated):
        t=self.t
        assert t.equal(ctx['observed_command_uid'],self.uid) and t.equal(ctx['observed_episode_uid'],self.episode)
        assert bool(self.active.all()) and len(errors)==3 and all(x.shape==(self.n,) for x in errors)
        first=self.ids[self.command_controls==0];self.first_acted[first]=self.current_control
        self.command_controls+=1;self.error+=t.stack(errors,1)
        moving=ctx['moving']&ctx['eligible'];self.moving_controls+=moving.long()
        self.moving_error+=t.stack(errors,1)*moving[:,None]
        self.zero_controls+=(ctx['command']==0).all(1).long()
        self.profile_bits|=t.bitwise_left_shift(t.ones_like(ctx['profile_key']),ctx['profile_key'])
        self.last_terminated=terminated.clone();self.last_truncated=truncated.clone()
        ids=self.ids[self.cycle_active]
        if not len(ids):return
        delta=t.atan2(t.sin(heading-ctx['heading']),t.cos(heading-ctx['heading']))
        sign=self.cycle_sign;self.cycle_turn[ids]+=delta[ids]*sign[ids]
        displacement=root_xy-ctx['before_root_xy']
        projection=displacement[:,0]*t.cos(ctx['direction'])+displacement[:,1]*t.sin(ctx['direction'])
        reference=ctx['command'][:,0]*t.cos(ctx['heading']-ctx['direction'])-ctx['command'][:,1]*t.sin(ctx['heading']-ctx['direction'])
        self.cycle_progress[ids]+=projection[ids];self.cycle_ref[ids]+=.02*reference[ids];self.cycle_count[ids]+=1
        phase=0 if self.current_control<100 else 1
        self.cycle_cross_phase[ids]|=self.cycle_start_phase[ids]!=phase
        complete=self.ids[self.cycle_active&(self.cycle_turn>=2*math.pi)]
        if len(complete):
            bucket=t.where(self.cycle_cross_phase[complete],2,self.cycle_start_phase[complete])
            key=self.cycle_key[complete];index=(bucket,key,complete)
            self.cycle_events[index]+=1;self.cycle_nonterminal_events[index]+=(~(terminated[complete]|truncated[complete])).long()
            seconds=self.cycle_count[complete].float()*.02
            self.cycle_seconds[index]+=seconds;self.cycle_displacement[index]+=self.cycle_progress[complete]
            self.cycle_reference[index]+=self.cycle_ref[complete]
            self.cycle_overshoot[index]+=self.cycle_turn[complete]-2*math.pi
            columns=dict(env_id=complete,episode_uid=self.episode[complete],original_E1_episode=self.source_episode[complete],command_uid=self.uid[complete],profile=key,
                start_observed=self.known[complete],first_control=self.cycle_first_control[complete],last_control=t.full_like(complete,self.current_control),
                controls=self.cycle_count[complete],seconds=seconds,sampled_signed_turn_rad=self.cycle_turn[complete],
                angular_overshoot_rad=self.cycle_turn[complete]-2*math.pi,world_direction=self.cycle_direction[complete],
                actual_projected_displacement_m=self.cycle_progress[complete],actual_progress_m_s=self.cycle_progress[complete]/seconds,
                sampled_BODY_reference_displacement_m=self.cycle_ref[complete],sampled_BODY_reference_progress_m_s=self.cycle_ref[complete]/seconds,
                terminal_non_timeout=terminated[complete],terminal_timeout=truncated[complete],phase_bucket=bucket)
            self._write_columns(self.cycle_records,columns,dict(complete_sampled_span=True,
                nominal_world_progress_m_s=.5,reference_quadrature='original pre-control BODY reference at sampled heading; left endpoint',
                endpoint_is_original_sample_no_interpolation=True,cycle_event_NOT_skill_success=True))
            # No angular overshoot credit is carried to an unrelated new anchor.
            self.cycle_active[complete]=False

    def _write_columns(self,writer,columns,extra):
        cpu={key:value.detach().cpu().tolist() for key,value in columns.items()}
        size=len(next(iter(cpu.values())))
        for i in range(size):writer.append({**{key:value[i] for key,value in cpu.items()},**extra})

    def _partial_cycle(self,ids,reason):
        ids=ids[self.cycle_active[ids]]
        if not len(ids):return
        self.cycle_partial[self.cycle_key[ids],ids]+=1
        self._write_columns(self.cycle_records,dict(env_id=ids,episode_uid=self.episode[ids],original_E1_episode=self.source_episode[ids],command_uid=self.cycle_uid[ids],
            profile=self.cycle_key[ids],controls=self.cycle_count[ids],sampled_signed_turn_rad=self.cycle_turn[ids],
            actual_projected_displacement_m=self.cycle_progress[ids]),
            dict(complete_sampled_span=False,end_reason=reason,no_exposure_is_pending_not_automatic_policy_failure=True))
        self.cycle_active[ids]=False

    def close(self,ids,reason,natural_timer_end=False):
        assert reason in ('reset','resample','window_end')
        ids=ids[self.active[ids]]
        if not len(ids):return
        self._partial_cycle(ids,reason)
        key=self.sample_key[ids];index=(key,ids);count=self.command_controls[ids]
        acted=count>0;known=self.known[ids]
        full=known&acted&bool(reason=='resample' and natural_timer_end)
        self.closed[index]+=1;self.acted[index]+=acted.long();self.zero[index]+=(~acted).long()
        self.complete[index]+=full.long();self.left[index]+=(~known).long()
        self.reset[index]+=int(reason=='reset');self.window[index]+=int(reason=='window_end')
        self.complete_controls[index]+=self.t.where(full,count,self.t.zeros_like(count))
        self.complete_moving_controls[index]+=self.t.where(full,self.moving_controls[ids],self.t.zeros_like(count))
        for j in range(3):
            self.complete_errors[key,j,ids]+=self.t.where(full,self.error[ids,j],self.t.zeros_like(self.error[ids,j]))
            self.complete_moving_errors[key,j,ids]+=self.t.where(full,self.moving_error[ids,j],self.t.zeros_like(self.error[ids,j]))
        self._write_columns(self.instance_records,dict(env_id=ids,episode_uid=self.episode[ids],original_E1_episode=self.source_episode[ids],command_uid=self.uid[ids],
            sampled_profile=key,start_observed=known,population_controls=count,acted_instance=acted,
            fully_observed_natural_command_lifetime=full,boundary_observed_control_index=self.first_control[ids],
            original_start_physics_tick=self.start_tick[ids],first_acted_control_index=self.first_acted[ids],
            last_control=self.t.full_like(ids,self.current_control),sampled_BODY_command3=self.sample_command[ids],
            sampled_world_direction=self.sample_direction[ids],sampled_signed_yaw_rad_s=self.sample_yaw[ids],
            actual_start_timer_s=self.start_timer[ids],acted_profile_bitset=self.profile_bits[ids],
            errors_sum=self.error[ids],moving_only_population_controls=self.moving_controls[ids],moving_only_errors_sum=self.moving_error[ids],
            actual_zero_command_population_controls=self.zero_controls[ids],
            last_non_timeout_mask=self.last_terminated[ids],last_timeout_mask=self.last_truncated[ids]),
            dict(end_reason=reason,original_timer_expired_observed=bool(natural_timer_end),
                original_start_unknown_if_not_observed=True,zero_control_NOT_skill_denominator=True))
        self.active[ids]=False

    def finish(self):

            profiles.append(dict(sampled_profile=p,closed_instance_events=int(self.closed[p].sum()),
                acted_instance_events=int(self.acted[p].sum()),zero_control_instance_events=int(self.zero[p].sum()),
                unique_env_with_acted_instance=int((self.acted[p]>0).sum()),
                fully_observed_natural_command_events=int(self.complete[p].sum()),
                unique_env_with_complete_command=int((self.complete[p]>0).sum()),
                left_censored_events=int(self.left[p].sum()),reset_ended_events=int(self.reset[p].sum()),window_ended_events=int(self.window[p].sum()),
                complete_command_population_controls=den,
                complete_command_MAE_by_sampled_profile=[float(self.complete_errors[p,j].sum())/den if den else None for j in range(3)],
                complete_command_moving_only_population_controls=moving,
                complete_command_moving_only_MAE_by_sampled_profile=[float(self.complete_moving_errors[p,j].sum())/moving if moving else None for j in range(3)],

"""Read-only W35 telemetry component; no SDK import, policy, RNG draw, or writer.

This is a source candidate, not an admitted runtime or a complete WM dataset.
All tensor operations use the caller's existing torch/device. No default CUDA.
"""
import gzip

import types

from tensordict import TensorDictBase
from pathlib import Path

MODEL_SHA = 'ad504fec819b22f10fd1caf7befc59c1988c7609fe15373ab8851ef95942df3f'
METRICS = ('forward_abs_error', 'yaw_abs_error', 'height_abs_error', 'moving_world_progress_abs_error')
FAMILIES = ('outside', 'plane_for_rm', 'tiny_step', 'slope_for_rm_high', 'inv_slope_for_rm_low', 'random_uniform_for_rm')
MODES = ('gentle', 'standing', 'negative_straight', 'positive_straight', 'negative_world_yaw', 'positive_world_yaw', 'eligible_without_retained_mode')


def tensor(value):
    return value.torch if hasattr(value, 'torch') else value


def encode_snapshot_mapping_key(key):
    if key is None:return dict(kind='none')
    if isinstance(key,bool):return dict(kind='bool',value=key)
    if isinstance(key,int):return dict(kind='int',value=key)
    if isinstance(key,str):return dict(kind='str',value=key)
    if isinstance(key,float) and math.isfinite(key):return dict(kind='float',value=key)
    if isinstance(key,tuple):return dict(kind='tuple',items=[encode_snapshot_mapping_key(k) for k in key])
    raise TypeError('Unsupported snapshot mapping key type: ' + type(key).__name__)


class ProfileBook:
    """Fresh run-local counters; profile x actual environment denominators.

    Counts are exposure, not success. Full and steady are independently readable
    via phase0+phase1 and phase1. No legacy audit lifetime counters are consumed.
    """
    def __init__(self, torch, n, device, reason_names):
        self.t = torch
        self.n = n
        self.ids = torch.arange(n, device=device)
        self.reason_names = tuple(reason_names)
        self.count = torch.zeros((2, 42, n), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        self.errors = torch.zeros((2, 4, 42, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        self.terminated = torch.zeros_like(self.count)
        self.truncated = torch.zeros_like(self.count)
        self.reasons = torch.zeros((2, len(reason_names), 42, n), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        self.cycles = torch.zeros_like(self.count)
        self.longest_live = torch.zeros_like(self.count, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.previous_key = torch.full((n,), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        self.previous_uid = torch.full_like(self.previous_key, -1)
        self.previous_live = torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        self.age = torch.zeros(n, device=device)
        self.turn = torch.zeros_like(self.age)
        self.previous_phase = -1

    def observe(self, phase, key, uid, errors, heading_delta, signed_yaw, terminated, truncated, reasons):
        t = self.t
        assert phase in (0, 1) and key.shape == uid.shape == (self.n,)
        assert key.dtype == t.long and bool(((key >= 0) & (key < 42)).all())
        assert len(errors) == 4 and len(reasons) == len(self.reason_names)
        assert all(x.shape == (self.n,) and bool(t.isfinite(x).all()) for x in errors)
        assert terminated.dtype == truncated.dtype == t.bool
        assert all(x.dtype == t.bool and x.shape == (self.n,) for x in reasons)
        idx = (key, self.ids)
        self.count[phase][idx] += 1
        for m, value in enumerate(errors):
            self.errors[phase, m][idx] += value
        self.terminated[phase][idx] += terminated.to(t.int64)
        self.truncated[phase][idx] += truncated.to(t.int64)
        for m, value in enumerate(reasons):
            self.reasons[phase, m][idx] += value.to(t.int64)
        live = ~(terminated | truncated)
        same = (key == self.previous_key) & (uid == self.previous_uid) & self.previous_live
        if phase != self.previous_phase:
            same = t.zeros_like(same)
        self.age = t.where(same, self.age + .02, t.full_like(self.age, .02))
        self.turn = t.where(same, self.turn + heading_delta, heading_delta)
        current = self.longest_live[phase][idx]
        self.longest_live[phase][idx] = t.maximum(current, t.where(live, self.age, t.zeros_like(self.age)))
        moving = ((key % 7 == 4) | (key % 7 == 5)) & live & (phase == 1)
        turns = t.floor((self.turn * t.sign(signed_yaw)).clamp_min(0) / (2 * math.pi)).to(t.long)
        completed = t.where(moving, turns, t.zeros_like(turns))
        self.cycles[phase][idx] += completed
        self.turn -= t.sign(signed_yaw) * (2 * math.pi) * completed
        self.age = t.where(live, self.age, t.zeros_like(self.age))
        self.turn = t.where(live, self.turn, t.zeros_like(self.turn))
        self.previous_key = key.clone()
        self.previous_uid = uid.clone()
        self.previous_live = live.clone()
        self.previous_phase = phase

    def _views(self, scope):
        if scope == 'whole':
            return (self.count.sum(0), self.errors.sum(0), self.terminated.sum(0), self.truncated.sum(0),
                    self.reasons.sum(0), self.cycles.sum(0), self.longest_live.max(0).values)
        phase = 0 if scope == 'warmup' else 1
        return (self.count[phase], self.errors[phase], self.terminated[phase], self.truncated[phase],
                self.reasons[phase], self.cycles[phase], self.longest_live[phase])

    def summary(self):
        output = []
        for scope in ('whole', 'warmup', 'steady'):
            counts, errors, terminated, truncated, reasons, cycles, longest = self._views(scope)
            for p in range(42):
                count = counts[p]
                denominator = int(count.sum())
                means = {}
                for m, name in enumerate(METRICS):
                    applicable = m != 3 or p % 7 in (4, 5)
                    means[name] = float(errors[m, p].sum()) / denominator if denominator and applicable else None
                output.append(dict(
                    phase=scope, profile=p,
                    family=FAMILIES[p // 7], mode=MODES[p % 7],
                    population_control_denominator=denominator,
                    unique_exposed_env_denominator=int((count > 0).sum()),
                    means=means,
                    terminated_mask_events=int(terminated[p].sum()),
                    unique_env_with_terminated_mask=int((terminated[p] > 0).sum()),
                    truncated_mask_events=int(truncated[p].sum()),
                    unique_env_with_truncated_mask=int((truncated[p] > 0).sum()),
                    reason_events={name: int(reasons[j, p].sum()) for j, name in enumerate(self.reason_names)},
                    reason_unique_env={name: int((reasons[j, p] > 0).sum()) for j, name in enumerate(self.reason_names)},
                    legacy_sampled_profile_turn_events_NOT_progress_qualification=int(cycles[p].sum()),
                    unique_env_with_legacy_profile_turn_event=int((cycles[p] > 0).sum()),
                    maximum_live_continuous_seconds=float(longest[p].max()),
                ))
        return output

    def condition_summary(self):
        output = []
        groups = dict(all=tuple(range(7)), gentle=(0,), standing=(1,), straight=(2, 3), moving_world_yaw=(4, 5), eligible_other=(6,))
        for scope in ('whole', 'warmup', 'steady'):
            count, errors, terminated, truncated, reasons, cycles, longest = self._views(scope)
            for name, modes in groups.items():
                profiles = [p for p in range(42) if p % 7 in modes]
                denominator = int(count[profiles].sum())
                means = {key: float(errors[m, profiles].sum()) / denominator if denominator and (m != 3 or name == 'moving_world_yaw') else None for m, key in enumerate(METRICS)}
                output.append(dict(phase=scope, condition=name, population_control_denominator=denominator,
                                   unique_exposed_env_denominator=int((count[profiles].sum(0) > 0).sum()),
                                   means=means, terminated_mask_events=int(terminated[profiles].sum()),
                                   unique_env_with_terminated_mask=int((terminated[profiles].sum(0) > 0).sum()),
                                   truncated_mask_events=int(truncated[profiles].sum()),
                                   legacy_sampled_profile_turn_events_NOT_progress_qualification=int(cycles[profiles].sum()),
                                   unique_env_with_legacy_profile_turn_event=int((cycles[profiles].sum(0) > 0).sum())))
        return output

    def export_sparse_per_env(self, path):
        # New output only. No existing NPZ is opened or decoded.
        import numpy as np
        phase, profile, env_id = (self.count > 0).nonzero(as_tuple=True)
        indexes = (phase, profile, env_id)
        data = dict(phase=phase.cpu().numpy(), profile=profile.cpu().numpy(), env_id=env_id.cpu().numpy(),
                    population_controls=self.count[indexes].cpu().numpy(),
                    terminated_events=self.terminated[indexes].cpu().numpy(),
                    truncated_events=self.truncated[indexes].cpu().numpy(),
                    cycle_events=self.cycles[indexes].cpu().numpy(),
                    longest_live_seconds=self.longest_live[indexes].cpu().numpy())
        for m, name in enumerate(METRICS):
            data[name + '_sum'] = self.errors[phase, m, profile, env_id].cpu().numpy()
        for m, name in enumerate(self.reason_names):
            data['reason_' + name + '_events'] = self.reasons[phase, m, profile, env_id].cpu().numpy()
        with Path(path).open('xb') as f:
            np.savez_compressed(f, **data)


class W35DomainPanel:
    """Hooks only original queue return values, reset IDs and termination caches.

    It never changes commands, actions, reset IDs, RNG, physics, queue ordering,
    model state, or optimizer. Original exceptions propagate. The queue target
    is labelled before original articulation apply, not torque/force truth.
    """
    def __init__(self, real, torch, output, task):
        assert task['kind'] == 'MOD4_W35_ADAPTED92_NEW86_EARLY_UID_CYCLE_V2'
        assert task['source_SHA'] == MODEL_SHA and task['controls'] == 800 and task['warmup_controls'] == 100
        assert real.num_envs == 20000 and real.physics_dt == .0025 and real.step_dt == .02 and real.cfg.decimation == 8
        assert real._physics_action_delay.queue.control_us == 20000
        self.real = real
        self.t = torch
        self.out = Path(output)
        self.task = task
        self.robot = real.scene['robot']
        self.names = tuple(real.termination_manager.active_terms)
        self.book = ProfileBook(torch, real.num_envs, real.device, self.names)
        self.uid = torch.zeros(real.num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=real.device)
        self.stream = gzip.open(self.out / 'W35_selected_profile_domain_before_terminal_reset.jsonl.gz', 'xb')
        self.bytes_written = 0
        self.limit = 512 * 1024 ** 2
        self.retention_limited = False
        self.trace_controls = []
        self.frame = None
        self.selected = torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long, device=real.device)
        self.terminal_count = 0
        self.control = None
        self.old_apply = real._physics_action_delay.queue.apply
        self.old_reset = real._reset_idx
        self.installed = False
        self._write(dict(kind='W35_frozen_profile_domain_diagnostic_v1', source_SHA=MODEL_SHA,
                         physics_dt_s=.0025, control_dt_s=.02, decimation=8, policy_hz=50, feedback_hz=100,
                         num_envs=real.num_envs, selection='first4 current IDs per actual profile; no RNG; at trace controls only',
                         state_layout='root13+q30+dq30, not pack127',
                         queue_target_semantics='queue.apply returned processed position/velocity targets before original articulation apply, not actual torque',
                         domain=task['domain_binding'], output_retention_uncompressed_limit_bytes=self.limit,
                         no_complete_WM_dataset=True, no_skill_graduation=True))

        def apply(key, tick):
            value = self.old_apply(key, tick)
            if self.frame is not None:
                q = real._physics_action_delay.queue
                self.frame['physical_queue_targets'].append(dict(
                    group=key, physics_tick_before_integration=int(tick),
                    selected_queue_target=self._snapshot(value),
                    timing_receipt=self._snapshot(q.receipt(key, tick))))
            return value

        panel = self
        def reset(this, env_ids):
            ids = torch.as_tensor(env_ids, device=real.device, dtype=torch.long)
            # Original is called exactly once with the original argument object.
            result = panel.old_reset(env_ids)
            panel.uid[ids] += 1
            if panel.frame is not None:
                panel.frame['resets_after_terminal'].append(dict(
                    actual_reset_env_ids=ids.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                    selected_post_reset=panel._physical(),
                    selected_DR_after_reset=panel._domain()))
            return result
        real._physics_action_delay.queue.apply = apply
        real._reset_idx = types.MethodType(reset, real)
        self.installed = True

    def _snapshot(self, value, path=''):
        t = self.t
        if t.is_tensor(value):
            rng = any(x in path.lower() for x in ('rng', 'generator'))
            per_env = value.ndim > 0 and value.shape[0] == self.real.num_envs and not rng
            v = value[self.selected] if per_env else value
            return dict(dtype=str(v.dtype), shape=list(v.shape), original_shape=list(value.shape),
                        axis0_is_selected_env=per_env, value=v.detach().cpu().tolist())
        if isinstance(value, TensorDictBase):
            items = list(value.items())
            if not all(isinstance(k, str) for k, _ in items):
                raise TypeError('Non-string TensorDict key at ' + path)
            original_batch = list(value.batch_size)
            selected_batch = list(original_batch)
            if original_batch and original_batch[0] == self.real.num_envs and not any(x in path.lower() for x in ('rng', 'generator')):
                selected_batch[0] = len(self.selected)
            return dict(container_type='tensordict.TensorDictBase',
                        concrete_type=type(value).__module__ + '.' + type(value).__qualname__,
                        original_batch_size=original_batch, snapshot_batch_size=selected_batch,
                        original_device=str(value.device) if value.device is not None else None,
                        entries={k: self._snapshot(v, path + '/' + k) for k, v in items})
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            items = list(value.items())
            if all(isinstance(k, str) for k, _ in items):
                return {k: self._snapshot(v, path + '/' + k) for k, v in items}
            return dict(container_type='typed_key_mapping',
                        concrete_type=type(value).__module__ + '.' + type(value).__qualname__,
                        entries=[dict(key=encode_snapshot_mapping_key(k), value=self._snapshot(v, path + '/' + str(k))) for k, v in items])
        if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
            return [self._snapshot(v, path + '/' + str(i)) for i, v in enumerate(value)]
        if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
            return value
        raise TypeError('Unsupported actual domain value at ' + path + ': ' + type(value).__name__)

    def _physical(self):
        r = self.robot
        return dict(env_ids=self.selected.detach().cpu().tolist(), local_episode_uid=self._snapshot(self.uid),
                    root13=self._snapshot(tensor(r.data.root_state_w)),
                    q30=self._snapshot(tensor(r.data.joint_pos)), dq30=self._snapshot(tensor(r.data.joint_vel)),
                    ground_z=self._snapshot(self.real._mod4_ground_z))

    def _domain(self):
        e = self.real
        # Existing restored objects only; lazy constructors/getters are avoided.
        data = dict(sensor_DR=e._sensor_mild.state_dict(), feedback_delay=e._feedback_delay_mild.state_dict(),
                    physical_action_delay=e._physics_action_delay.state_dict(),
                    spring_pressure=e._spring_pressure.state_dict(), gas_damping=e._gas_damping.state_dict(),
                    chassis_COM=e._chassis_com.state_dict(), chassis_PD=e._explicit_pd.state_dict(),
                    actual_cached_stiffness_N_m=tensor(self.robot.data.joint_stiffness)[:, e._spring_pressure.ids],
                    actual_cached_damping_N_s_m=tensor(self.robot.data.joint_damping)[:, e._spring_pressure.ids],
                    nominal_stiffness_N_m=e._spring_pressure.nominal)
        return self._snapshot(data)

    def _write(self, row):
        raw = (json.dumps(row, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
        if self.bytes_written + len(raw) > self.limit:
            self.retention_limited = True
            return False
        self.stream.write(raw)
        self.bytes_written += len(raw)
        return True

    def begin(self, index, ctx):
        assert self.control is None
        self.control = index
        self.start_tick = int(self.real._integrated_contact.tick)
        self.start_feedback = int(self.real._feedback_100hz_tick)
        self.before_uid = self.uid.clone()
        self.terminal_count = 0
        self.frame = None
        if not self.retention_limited and (index < 24 or (index >= 100 and (index - 100) % 10 == 0)):
            selected = [(ctx['profile_key'] == p).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0][:4] for p in range(42)]
            self.selected = self.t.cat(selected)
            self.frame = dict(control=index+1, phase='warmup' if index < 100 else 'steady',
                              start_physics_tick=self.start_tick, start_feedback_tick=self.start_feedback,
                              actual_before=self._physical(), DR_before=self._domain(),
                              profile_key_before=self._snapshot(ctx['profile_key']),
                              observed_original_command_uid_before=self._snapshot(ctx['observed_command_uid']),
                              actual_command3=self._snapshot(ctx['command']),
                              world_direction=self._snapshot(ctx['direction']),
                              physical_queue_targets=[], resets_after_terminal=[])

    def requested(self, action, obs):
        if self.frame is not None:
            self.frame['raw_actor_ingress6'] = self._snapshot(action)
            self.frame['observations_given_to_original_actor'] = self._snapshot(obs)

    def terminal(self, ctx):
        self.terminal_count += 1
        assert self.terminal_count == 1
        t, e, r = self.t, self.real, self.robot
        tm = e.termination_manager
        key = ctx['profile_key']
        moving = (key % 7 == 4) | (key % 7 == 5)
        assert bool(t.equal(moving, ctx['moving']))
        heading = tensor(r.data.heading_w)
        delta = t.atan2(t.sin(heading - ctx['heading']), t.cos(heading - ctx['heading']))
        world = tensor(r.data.root_lin_vel_w)
        progress = world[:, 0] * t.cos(ctx['direction']) + world[:, 1] * t.sin(ctx['direction'])
        errors = [(ctx['command'][:, 0] - tensor(r.data.root_lin_vel_b)[:, 0]).abs(),
                  (ctx['command'][:, 2] - tensor(r.data.root_ang_vel_b)[:, 2]).abs(),
                  (tensor(r.data.root_pos_w)[:, 2] - e._mod4_ground_z - .25).abs(),
                  t.where(moving, (progress - .5).abs(), t.zeros_like(progress))]
        self.book.observe(0 if self.control < 100 else 1, key, ctx['observed_command_uid'], errors, delta, ctx['command'][:, 2],
                          tm.terminated, tm.time_outs, [tm.get_term(n).bool() for n in self.names])
        if self.frame is not None:
            self.frame['terminal_before_autoreset'] = self._physical()
            self.frame['DR_terminal_before_autoreset'] = self._domain()
            self.frame['action_manager_ingress6_after_original_processing'] = self._snapshot(e.action_manager.action)
            self.frame['terminated_mask'] = self._snapshot(tm.terminated)
            self.frame['truncated_mask'] = self._snapshot(tm.time_outs)
            self.frame['reason_masks'] = {n: self._snapshot(tm.get_term(n).bool()) for n in self.names}

    def after_step(self, done, info):
        assert self.terminal_count == 1
        assert int(self.real._integrated_contact.tick) - self.start_tick == 8
        assert int(self.real._feedback_100hz_tick) - self.start_feedback == 2
        if self.frame is not None:
            for group in ('legs', 'wheels'):
                ticks = [x['physics_tick_before_integration'] for x in self.frame['physical_queue_targets'] if x['group'] == group]
                assert ticks == list(range(self.start_tick, self.start_tick + 8)), (group, ticks, self.start_tick)
            self.frame['end_physics_tick'] = int(self.real._integrated_contact.tick)
            self.frame['end_feedback_tick'] = int(self.real._feedback_100hz_tick)
            self.frame['returned_done_after_autoreset'] = self._snapshot(done)
            self.frame['returned_info_keys_only'] = sorted(info)
            self.frame['post_step_after_autoreset'] = self._physical()
            if self._write(self.frame):
                self.trace_controls.append(self.control + 1)
        self.frame = None
        self.control = None

    def uninstall(self):
        if self.installed:
            self.real._physics_action_delay.queue.apply = self.old_apply
            self.real._reset_idx = self.old_reset
            self.installed = False
        self.stream.close()

    def finish(self):
        assert self.control is None
        self.uninstall()
        self.book.export_sparse_per_env(self.out / 'W35_profile_phase_env_fresh_denominators_sums_events.npz')
        report = dict(kind='W35_profile_env_domain_panel_diagnostic_v1', source_SHA=MODEL_SHA,
                      profile_phase_metrics=self.book.summary(), condition_phase_metrics=self.book.condition_summary(), trace_controls=self.trace_controls,
                      trace_uncompressed_bytes=self.bytes_written, trace_retention_limited=self.retention_limited,
                      actual_local_episode_uid_final=self.uid.detach().cpu().tolist(),
                      domain_binding=self.task['domain_binding'],
                      errors_are_actual_population_control_weighted=True,
                      continuous_definition='live completed intervals only; break on profile/phase/episode change or done; no cross-reset credit',
                      unique_env_is_not_unique_episode=True, signed_cycle_event_is_not_unique_env=True,
                      no_per_profile_success_threshold_invented=True,
                      complete_WM_dataset=False, skill_graduation=False,
                      cycle_progress_metric_source='ONLY W35_OBSERVED_COMMAND_UID_AND_CYCLES_ACTUAL.json; old ProfileBook turn counters are labelled legacy',
                      pending='Original task acceptance and uncovered exposure remain pending; no new numerical graduation line')
        with (self.out / 'W35_PROFILE_ENV_DOMAIN_PANEL_ACTUAL.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
